limitations: Raw snapshots are diagnostic CPU readbacks, excluded from throughput.
Active cancellation uses actual inference dispatch; runtime failure uses the real missing-input error; device destruction occurs during actual inference submission.
Destroyed-device canvas contents are not asserted; failed command returns no output and explicit fresh-generation pixels match the reference.
Application leases/tensors/session/explicit resource counters do not measure total driver or opaque runtime memory.
The sampled playback command flag is not an ordinary AI On audio-clock/UI acceptance test.
